parole.significato: Forms imperfective verbs from perfective verbs.
Suffix appended to words to create an adjective.
Forms abstract nouns from adjectives, denoting a quality.
to talk confusedly because of a sickness
price (cost required to gain possession of something)
hungry (affected by hunger; desirous of food)
plot of land for sowing, a partition of agriculturally or horticulturally used earth, farming bed, a strip of farmland
to stamp, to pound, to bruise
to ask, to make a request
horn, antler (growth on the heads of certain animals)
hay of the first mowing in a year
force (anything that is able to make a big changes in person or thing)
widow (a woman whose husband has died)
to rule, to reign, to govern
wall (structure built for defense surrounding or separating an area)
to reap, harvest (cut with a sickle, scythe, or reaping machine)
